turn_1.decision_relevance: Directly measures the customer’s promotion criterion and supports a per-tenant-class promotion decision.
turn_1.expected_observation: Held-out p99 measurements by tenant class may show whether each class is below 250 ms; the mean improvement alone does not establish this, so at least one class may still exceed the objective.

turn_2.lesson: Aggregate mean improvement can conceal a tenant-specific p99 regression; promotion must satisfy the p99 objective and non-inferiority for every tenant class.
